comment: Global application state — lives OUTSIDE chart definitions and data (URL/store, never in export files). Selections persist when switching charts/indicators; a chart simply ignores state it does not use. Deviation from the ChatGPT thread: `categories` stores selected IDs at ANY level (Approach A), not expanded leaves, because adjusted rates cannot be aggregated from children — the app resolves parent/child display via the shared hierarchy, including partial-selection rendering.
